channel.description: Latest articles from BK Reader (The Brooklyn Reader) (bkreader.com)

item.title: Brooklyn Public Library Hosts Engineers Week Youth Competition
item.description: Brooklyn teens spent their mid-winter break learning about energy conservation and equity, presenting animation, game design and digital art projects to National Grid engineers.

item.title: Suspect Sought For Bank Withdrawal Theft in Sunset Park
item.description: Investigators say the 38-year-old victim received an alert that an unauthorized withdrawal was made at the Chase Bank on 8th Avenue and 55th Street.

item.title: Man Wanted For Exposing Himself in East New York Subway Station
item.description: Investigators say it happened as the 41-year-old victim was near the turnstiles on Feb. 9 around 9:00am.

item.title: New SNAP Work Rules in Effect in New York
item.description: New York State has started to implement new, stricter rules for Able-Bodies Adults With Independents (ABAWD), who now must work or participate in training for 80 hours per month to avoid losing their SNAP benefits.

item.title: Donate Blood, Win Brooklyn Nets Tickets
item.description: From March 1 through March 5, all regular blood donors who make a donation at New York Blood center's Brooklyn Donor Center will be entered into a daily sweepstakes, drawing five winners each day, for a chance to win two tickets to the Nets vs. Hawks game on April 3 at Barclays Center.

item.title: Brooklyn College Adds Streamlined Master’s in Finance
item.description: The new, 30-credit program will launch in the fall of 2026 and will allow graduates to step into high‑impact roles such as financial analyst, portfolio manager, investment consultant, risk manager, and fintech specialist.

item.title: NY AG Backs Brooklyn's Reynoso For Congress
item.description: "In Congress, I know he will fight back against the president’s agenda and work for an economy that benefits the working class, not the billionaires," New York Attorney General Letitia James said as she endorsed Antonio Reynoso to represent New York's 7th congressional district.

item.title: Continued Investment in Health Programs is Critical to All New Yorkers
item.description: Op-Ed: Funding programs to help more students pursue a career in medicine is essential to the state’s wellbeing.

item.title: Brooklyn’s Weeksville Finalizes Major Preservation Milestone
item.description: The restoration of the Hunterfly Road Houses at the Weeksville Heritage Center preserves four wood-frame homes built in the 19th century that stand as the last remaining structures of one of the nation’s largest free Black communities before the Civil War.
